blocks.text: should — maslahat, fikr va kutilgan natija

**should** + fe'l bilan maslahat berishni qizil kitobdan bilasiz (→ qizil kitob, 32-dars): You **should** rest — Dam olishingiz kerak. Bu darsda should ning boshqa qirralari ko'riladi: u **must** dan qanchalik kuchsiz, **I don't think ... should** qolipi, kutilgan narsani bildirish («...sa kerak»), o'tmishdagi xato — **should have done**, hamda **ought to** va **should be doing**. O'zbekchada should ga ko'pincha «**-ish kerak**», «**-gani ma'qul**», o'tmishda esa «**-ish kerak edi**» to'g'ri keladi.

items.text: You **should** try the new Georgian restaurant near the park.
items.translation: Bog' yonidagi yangi gruzin restoranini **sinab ko'rishingiz kerak**.

items.text: Kids **shouldn't** drink energy drinks — they're full of caffeine.
items.translation: Bolalar energetik ichimlik **ichmasligi kerak** — ular kofeinga to'la.

blocks.text: **should** — tavsiya: «shunday qilsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi», lekin hech kim majburlamaydi. **must** — ancha kuchli: so'zlovchi buni zarur deb biladi yoki bu qoida (→ 31–32-darslar). You **should** see a doctor — oddiy maslahat; You **must** see a doctor immediately — vaziyat jiddiy, kechiktirib bo'lmaydi. O'zbekchada ham shunday daraja bor: «ko'rinsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi» → «ko'rinishingiz kerak» → «**albatta**, darhol ko'rining».

items.text: You **should** wear sunscreen at the beach, even on cloudy days.
items.translation: Plyajda, hatto bulutli kunda ham, quyoshdan himoya kremi **surtishingiz kerak**.

items.text: You **must** wear a seat belt in the back too — it's the law.
items.translation: Orqa o'rindiqda ham xavfsizlik kamarini **taqishingiz shart** — bu qonun.

blocks.text: I don't think ... should — inkorni oldinga oling

Ingliz tilida «menimcha, ...maslik kerak» fikri odatda **I don't think** you **should** ... qolipida aytiladi: inkor «think» ga o'tadi. «I think you shouldn't ...» grammatik jihatdan xato emas, lekin kamroq ishlatiladi va keskinroq eshitiladi. Fikr so'rash: **Do you think** I **should** ...? Maslahat so'rash: **Should** I ...? / What **should** I ...? Esda tuting: **Why should** I ...? ko'pincha savol emas, norozilik: «Nega endi men ...ishim kerak ekan?»

items.text: I don't think you **should** sell your car — you'll need it in winter.
items.translation: Menimcha, mashinangizni **sotmaganingiz ma'qul** — qishda kerak bo'ladi.

items.text: Do you think we **should** invite Oliver to the dinner?
items.translation: Sizningcha, Oliverni kechki ovqatga **taklif qilishimiz kerakmi**?

items.text: Why **should** I pay for a mistake that the bank made?
items.translation: Bank qilgan xato uchun nega endi men **to'lashim kerak**?

blocks.text: should faqat maslahat emas. U biror narsa **kutilayotganini**, ehtimoli katta ekanini ham bildiradi: The parcel **should** arrive tomorrow — Posilka ertaga **kelishi kerak**. O'zbekchada «**...sa kerak**», «**...ishi kerak**». Shuningdek, holat **bo'lishi kerak bo'lgandek emasligini** ham aytadi: The heating **should** be on, but it's cold — Isitish yoqilgan bo'lishi kerak edi, lekin sovuq. Farqiga e'tibor bering: **must** (→ 28-dars) — dalilga asoslangan xulosa («aniq shunday»), **should** — umid va kutish («hamma narsa rejadagidek ketsa, shunday bo'ladi»).

items.text: The meeting **should** finish by four, so I can pick you up at five.
items.translation: Yig'ilish soat to'rtgacha **tugasa kerak**, shuning uchun seni beshda olib keta olaman.

items.text: There **shouldn't** be any problems with your visa this time.
items.translation: Bu safar vizangiz bilan hech qanday muammo **bo'lmasa kerak**.

blocks.text: should have done — o'tmishdagi xato va afsus

**should have** + V3 — o'tmishda to'g'ri ish shu edi, **lekin u qilinmadi**: I **should have saved** the file — Faylni **saqlashim kerak edi** (saqlamadim). **shouldn't have** + V3 — harakat **qilindi, lekin bu xato edi**: You **shouldn't have told** her — Unga **aytmasligingiz kerak edi** (aytdingiz). Ikkalasi ham afsus yoki tanqid ohangida. Kutish ma'nosida ham ishlatiladi: They **should have arrived** by now — Ular allaqachon **yetib kelishi kerak edi** (lekin hali xabar yo'q). Og'zaki nutqda **should've** deb qisqartiriladi.

items.text: We **should have bought** the tickets online — now the queue is enormous.
items.translation: Chiptalarni onlayn **olishimiz kerak edi** — endi navbat juda uzun.

items.text: You **shouldn't have left** the door unlocked while we were away.
items.translation: Biz yo'qligimizda eshikni **qulflamasdan qoldirmasligingiz kerak edi**.

blocks.text: ought to va should be doing

**ought to** + fe'l — **should** ning ma'nodoshi: You **ought to** rest = You **should** rest. U biroz rasmiyroq va kamroq ishlatiladi; inkor shakli **oughtn't to** juda kam uchraydi, odatda **shouldn't** aytiladi. O'tmish: **ought to have done** = should have done. **should be** + `-ing` esa aynan hozir boshqa ish qilinayotgan bo'lishi kerakligini bildiradi: You **should be studying**, not playing games! — Hozir o'yin emas, **dars qilayotgan bo'lishing kerak**!

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «You should to go» → You **should go** (should dan keyin `to` yo'q; `to` faqat **ought to** da); «I should went» yoki «I should have go» → I **should have gone** (o'tmish — have + V3); «I think you shouldn't come» → tabiiyroq: I **don't think** you **should** come; «He should have come» ni «U kelgan bo'lsa kerak» deb tarjima qilish → bu **must have come** (→ 28-dars), should have come esa «**kelishi kerak edi** (lekin kelmadi)».

should have done ni o'zbekcha «**...ishim kerak edi, lekin ...madim**» qolipiga qo'yib tekshiring: «Ertaroq chiqishim kerak edi, lekin chiqmadim» — I **should have left** earlier. Gapning ikkinchi yarmi ma'noga mos kelsa, shakl to'g'ri tanlangan.

examples.title: **should**: advice and the right thing to do
examples.description: should / shouldn't + fe'l — maslahat yoki umuman to'g'ri deb hisoblangan ish. must dan yumshoqroq: tavsiya, majburiyat emas.

sentences.text: You **should** take a break — you've been staring at that screen for hours.
sentences.translation: Biroz **dam olishingiz kerak** — soatlardan beri ekranga tikilib o'tiribsiz.

sentences.text: If you're going to Khiva in July, you **should** take a hat and plenty of water.
sentences.translation: Iyulda Xivaga borsangiz, shlyapa va ko'p suv **olib olganingiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Everyone **should** learn basic first aid; it can save a life.
sentences.translation: Har bir kishi birinchi tibbiy yordam asoslarini **bilishi kerak**: bu hayotni saqlab qolishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Bekzod **should** ask for a pay rise — he does far more than anyone else in the team.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **maosh oshirishni so'rashi kerak** — u jamoadagi hammadan ko'proq ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Parents **shouldn't** let young children use social media without supervision.
sentences.translation: Ota-onalar yosh bolalarga ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan nazoratsiz **foydalanishga ruxsat bermasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: This cough isn't getting better, so you **should** really see a doctor.
sentences.translation: Bu yo'tal yaxshilanmayapti, shuning uchun rostdan ham **shifokorga ko'rinishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: We **should** book the hotel in Samarkand now, before prices go up for the holidays.
sentences.translation: Bayram oldidan narxlar oshmasidan, Samarqanddagi mehmonxonani hozir **band qilishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Drivers **shouldn't** rely completely on GPS when they're in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Tog'larda haydovchilar butunlay GPSga **tayanmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Students who want a scholarship **should** apply early, as places are limited.
sentences.translation: Grant olishni istagan talabalar erta **hujjat topshirishi kerak**, chunki o'rinlar cheklangan.

sentences.text: That film is really overrated — you **shouldn't** waste your money on it.
sentences.translation: U film haddan tashqari maqtalgan — unga **pul sarflamaganingiz ma'qul**.

examples.title: **I think** / **I don't think** ... **should**
examples.description: Fikr bildirish: I think ... should. Salbiy fikr odatda I don't think ... should qolipida aytiladi, «I think ... shouldn't» emas.

sentences.text: I think you **should** apply for the manager's job — you'd be great at it.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, menejer lavozimiga **ariza topshirishingiz kerak** — bu ishni zo'r uddalardingiz.

sentences.text: I don't think you **should** drive tonight; the roads are covered in ice.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, bugun kechqurun **mashina haydamasligingiz kerak**, yo'llarni muz qoplagan.

sentences.text: Do you think Kate **should** move to London for the job? — Yes, I think she should.
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, Keyt ish uchun Londonga **ko'chib o'tishi kerakmi**? — Ha, menimcha, ko'chishi kerak.

sentences.text: My father doesn't think I **should** change my university course in the second year.
sentences.translation: Otamning fikricha, ikkinchi kursda yo'nalishimni **o'zgartirmasligim kerak**.

sentences.text: In my opinion, the government **should** spend more on public transport.
sentences.translation: Mening fikrimcha, hukumat jamoat transportiga ko'proq **mablag' sarflashi kerak**.

sentences.text: Personally, I don't think children **should** have smartphones before the age of twelve.
sentences.translation: Shaxsan men bolalarda o'n ikki yoshgacha smartfon **bo'lmasligi kerak** deb o'ylayman.

sentences.text: Most experts think that adults **should** sleep at least seven hours a night.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik mutaxassislar kattalar kechasi kamida yetti soat **uxlashi kerak** deb hisoblashadi.

sentences.text: Aziz thinks we **should** wait until the spring before we sell the flat.
sentences.translation: Azizning fikricha, kvartirani sotishdan oldin bahorgacha **kutishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: I really don't think you **should** lend him any more money after last time.
sentences.translation: O'tgan safargi voqeadan keyin, menimcha, unga boshqa **qarz bermasligingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Where do you think we **should** go for our anniversary — Bukhara or the mountains?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, to'yimiz yilligiga qayerga **borganimiz ma'qul** — Buxorogami yoki tog'largami?

examples.title: Asking for advice: **Should I ...?** **What should we ...?**
examples.description: Maslahat so'rash: Should I / we ...? va so'roq so'zlari bilan. Why should I ...? — ko'pincha norozilik.

sentences.text: **Should** I call the client now, or **should** I wait until he replies to my email?
sentences.translation: Mijozga hozir **qo'ng'iroq qilaymi** yoki u xatimga javob berguncha **kutaymi**?

sentences.text: What **should** we do with the old furniture when we move?
sentences.translation: Ko'chib o'tganimizda eski mebellarni nima **qilganimiz ma'qul**?

sentences.text: **Should** we take a present for Dilnoza's parents when we visit them?
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning ota-onasinikiga borganda sovg'a **olib borishimiz kerakmi**?

sentences.text: Which laptop **should** I buy for video editing? — The lighter one, I think.
sentences.translation: Video montaj uchun qaysi noutbukni **olsam ekan**? — Menimcha, yengilrog'ini.

sentences.text: How much **should** we tip in a restaurant in London? — Usually about ten to fifteen percent.
sentences.translation: Londondagi restoranda qancha **choychaqa qoldirish kerak**? — Odatda o'n-o'n besh foiz.

sentences.text: **Shouldn't** we tell the neighbours about the party before it starts?
sentences.translation: Bazm boshlanishidan oldin qo'shnilarga **aytib qo'yishimiz kerak emasmi**?

sentences.text: Who **should** I contact if I lose my student card?
sentences.translation: Talabalik guvohnomamni yo'qotib qo'ysam, kimga **murojaat qilishim kerak**?

sentences.text: Do you think I **should** wear a suit to the interview, or is that too formal?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, suhbatga kostyum **kiyishim kerakmi** yoki bu juda rasmiy bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: When **should** Jasur start applying for jobs — before or after graduation?
sentences.translation: Jasur ishga ariza topshirishni qachon **boshlashi kerak** — bitirishdan oldinmi yoki keyinmi?

sentences.text: Why **should** I apologise when it was Tom who started the argument?
sentences.translation: Janjalni Tom boshlagan bo'lsa, nega endi men **kechirim so'rashim kerak**?

examples.title: Expectations: it **should** be ready by Friday
examples.description: should — kutilgan, ehtimoli katta narsa: «...sa kerak», «...ishi kerak». Shuningdek, bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan, lekin bunday bo'lmagan holat.

sentences.text: The parcel **should** arrive tomorrow — the tracking says it's already in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Posilka ertaga **yetib kelishi kerak** — kuzatuv tizimida u allaqachon Toshkentda deb yozilgan.

sentences.text: Sarah left an hour ago, so she **should** be home by now.
sentences.translation: Sara bir soat oldin chiqib ketgan, demak hozir uyda **bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: If you've done all the practice tests, the exam **shouldn't** be too difficult.
sentences.translation: Agar barcha sinov testlarini ishlagan bo'lsangiz, imtihon unchalik **qiyin bo'lmasa kerak**.

sentences.text: There **should** be plenty of seats on the train, because it's a weekday.
sentences.translation: Poyezdda bo'sh joy ko'p **bo'lsa kerak**, chunki bugun ish kuni.

sentences.text: We've got a strong team this year, so we **should** win the league.
sentences.translation: Bu yil jamoamiz kuchli, shuning uchun ligada **g'olib bo'lishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: The new road **should** cut the journey from Fergana to Tashkent by an hour.
sentences.translation: Yangi yo'l Farg'onadan Toshkentgacha bo'lgan safarni bir soatga **qisqartirishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Kate's an excellent cook, so tonight's dinner **should** be delicious.
sentences.translation: Keyt zo'r oshpaz, shuning uchun bugungi kechki ovqat mazali **bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: This label is wrong — the sale price **should** be twenty pounds, not thirty.
sentences.translation: Bu yorliq noto'g'ri — chegirmadagi narx o'ttiz emas, yigirma funt **bo'lishi kerak**.

sentences.text: The heating **should** be on, but the radiators are completely cold.
sentences.translation: Isitish **yoqilgan bo'lishi kerak**, lekin radiatorlar butunlay sovuq.

sentences.text: If the software update works properly, the phone **shouldn't** crash any more.
sentences.translation: Agar dastur yangilanishi to'g'ri ishlasa, telefon endi **qotib qolmasa kerak**.

examples.title: **should have done**: the right thing didn't happen
examples.description: should have + V3 — o'tmishda to'g'ri ish shu edi, lekin u qilinmadi: afsus yoki tanqid. Kutish ma'nosida ham: «allaqachon ...ishi kerak edi».

sentences.text: I **should have saved** the file before closing it — now the whole report is gone.
sentences.translation: Faylni yopishdan oldin **saqlab qo'yishim kerak edi** — endi butun hisobot yo'qoldi.

sentences.text: We **should have left** earlier; the traffic on the ring road was terrible.
sentences.translation: Ertaroq **chiqishimiz kerak edi**, halqa yo'lda tirbandlik dahshatli edi.

sentences.text: You **should have told** me you were vegetarian — I made lamb for everyone!
sentences.translation: Vegetarian ekaningizni menga **aytishingiz kerak edi** — hammaga qo'y go'shti pishirdim-ku!

sentences.text: Madina **should have studied** harder for her driving theory test, but she spent the week at her cousin's wedding.
sentences.translation: Madina haydovchilik nazariyasi imtihoniga yaxshiroq **tayyorlanishi kerak edi**, lekin u haftani amakivachchasining to'yida o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: The company **should have warned** its customers about the price increase much sooner.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya mijozlarini narx oshishi haqida ancha oldin **ogohlantirishi kerak edi**.

sentences.text: It was a fantastic concert — you **should have come** with us!
sentences.translation: Ajoyib konsert bo'ldi — biz bilan **kelsangiz bo'lardi**!

sentences.text: Looking back, Oliver **should have accepted** the job offer in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Hozir o'ylab qarasa, Oliver Edinburgdagi ish taklifini **qabul qilishi kerak edi**.

sentences.text: **Should** I **have called** the police when I saw the accident?
sentences.translation: Avariyani ko'rganimda politsiyaga **qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerakmidi**?

sentences.text: They **should have arrived** by now — I hope nothing has happened on the way.
sentences.translation: Ular allaqachon **yetib kelishlari kerak edi** — yo'lda biror narsa bo'lmagan bo'lsin-da.

sentences.text: Somebody **should have checked** the figures before the presentation went to the client.
sentences.translation: Taqdimot mijozga ketishidan oldin kimdir raqamlarni **tekshirishi kerak edi**.

examples.title: **shouldn't have done**: it was a mistake
examples.description: shouldn't have + V3 — harakat qilindi, lekin bu xato edi. O'zbekchada «-masligim kerak edi».

sentences.text: I **shouldn't have eaten** that second plate of plov — now I feel awful.
sentences.translation: O'sha ikkinchi likopcha palovni **yemasligim kerak edi** — endi o'zimni juda yomon his qilyapman.

sentences.text: You **shouldn't have shouted** at your sister; she was only trying to help.
sentences.translation: Singlingga **baqirmasliging kerak edi**, u faqat yordam bermoqchi edi.

sentences.text: James **shouldn't have posted** those photos online without asking his friends first.
sentences.translation: Jeyms o'sha suratlarni do'stlaridan so'ramasdan internetga **joylamasligi kerak edi**.

sentences.text: We **shouldn't have trusted** that website — the tickets turned out to be fake.
sentences.translation: O'sha saytga **ishonmasligimiz kerak edi** — chiptalar soxta bo'lib chiqdi.

sentences.text: Nilufar knows she **shouldn't have signed** the contract without reading the small print.
sentences.translation: Nilufar o'zi ham tushunadi: shartnomani mayda harflarda yozilgan shartlarini o'qimay **imzolamasligi kerak edi**.

sentences.text: The bus driver **shouldn't have been using** his phone while he was driving.
sentences.translation: Avtobus haydovchisi mashina haydayotganda telefondan **foydalanmasligi kerak edi**.

sentences.text: Oh no, I **shouldn't have said** that — I didn't mean to upset you.
sentences.translation: Voy, buni **aytmasligim kerak edi** — sizni xafa qilmoqchi emasdim.

sentences.text: Perhaps the referee **shouldn't have given** a penalty in the last minute.
sentences.translation: Balki hakam oxirgi daqiqada **penalti bermasligi kerak edi**.

sentences.text: Honestly, they **shouldn't have built** such an ugly hotel next to the old city walls.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, eski shahar devorlari yoniga bunday xunuk mehmonxona **qurmasliklari kerak edi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **shouldn't have lent** his car to his cousin — it came back with a broken mirror.
sentences.translation: Aziz mashinasini amakivachchasiga **bermasligi kerak edi** — mashina yon ko'zgusi singan holda qaytdi.

examples.title: **ought to** and **should be doing**
examples.description: ought to — should ning ma'nodoshi (biroz rasmiy); ought to have done — o'tmishda. should be + -ing — hozir boshqa ish qilinayotgan bo'lishi kerak.

sentences.text: You **ought to** visit Khiva at least once — the old town is like a museum.
sentences.translation: Xivaga hech bo'lmasa bir marta **borishingiz kerak** — eski shahar xuddi muzeyga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: We **ought to** thank our neighbours for looking after the cat while we were away.
sentences.translation: Biz yo'qligimizda mushukka qarab turgani uchun qo'shnilarga **minnatdorchilik bildirishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: The government **ought to** do more to protect small businesses.
sentences.translation: Hukumat kichik biznesni himoya qilish uchun ko'proq **ish qilishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Emma **ought to have checked** the train times before she left the house.
sentences.translation: Emma uydan chiqishdan oldin poyezd jadvalini **tekshirishi kerak edi**.

sentences.text: That restaurant got great reviews, so the food **ought to** be good.
sentences.translation: U restoran juda yaxshi baho olgan, demak ovqati yaxshi **bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Why are you playing games? You **should be revising** for your exam!
sentences.translation: Nega o'yin o'ynayapsan? Hozir imtihonga **tayyorlanayotgan bo'lishing kerak**-ku!

sentences.text: It's half past eight — Tom **should be working**, not sitting in the café.
sentences.translation: Soat sakkiz yarim — Tom kafeda o'tirmasdan, **ishlayotgan bo'lishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Passengers **shouldn't be standing** in the doorway while the train is moving.
sentences.translation: Poyezd harakatlanayotganda yo'lovchilar eshik oldida **turmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: I **ought to** go to bed now, but this series is too exciting to stop.
sentences.translation: Endi **uxlashim kerak**, lekin bu serial shunchalik qiziqki, to'xtatib bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: According to the instructions, you **should be using** a different charger for this phone.
sentences.translation: Yo'riqnomaga ko'ra, bu telefon uchun **boshqa quvvatlagichdan foydalanishingiz kerak**.

examples.title: Dialogue: advice about a difficult boss
examples.description: Suhbat: ikki do'st boshliq bilan bo'lgan muammo haqida gaplashadi — should, shouldn't have done, ought to aralash.

sentences.text: — Jasur, can I ask your advice? I don't know what I **should** do about my boss.
sentences.translation: — Jasur, maslahat so'rasam maylimi? Boshlig'im masalasida nima **qilishim kerakligini** bilmayapman.

sentences.text: — Of course. What's happened? You **should** tell me everything from the beginning.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Nima bo'ldi? Hammasini boshidan **aytib berishing kerak**.

sentences.text: — Yesterday he criticised my report in front of everyone. He **shouldn't have done** that, should he?
sentences.translation: — Kecha hisobotimni hammaning oldida tanqid qildi. U **bunday qilmasligi kerak edi**, to'g'rimi?

sentences.text: — No, he shouldn't. A good manager **ought to** give feedback in private.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri, qilmasligi kerak edi. Yaxshi rahbar tanqidni yuzma-yuz **aytishi kerak**.

sentences.text: — Maybe I **should have said** something at the meeting, but I was too shocked.
sentences.translation: — Balki yig'ilishda biror narsa **deyishim kerak edi**, lekin juda dovdirab qoldim.

sentences.text: — I don't think you **should** argue in public. Talk to him alone instead.
sentences.translation: — Menimcha, odamlar oldida **bahslashmaslik kerak**. Uning o'zi bilan yolg'iz gaplash.

sentences.text: — **Should** I write him an email first, or just knock on his door?
sentences.translation: — Avval unga xat **yozaymi** yoki shunchaki eshigini taqillatib kiraymi?

sentences.text: — An email is safer. And you **should** mention the positive feedback from the client too.
sentences.translation: — Xat xavfsizroq. Mijozning ijobiy fikrini ham **eslatib o'tishing kerak**.

sentences.text: — Good idea. That **should** show him the report wasn't so bad after all.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Bu unga hisobot unchalik yomon emasligini **ko'rsatsa kerak**.

sentences.text: — Exactly. And next time, you **shouldn't** wait a whole day to ask for advice!
sentences.translation: — Aynan. Keyingi safar esa maslahat so'rash uchun bir kun **kutib o'tirmasliging kerak**!
